verdict.rationale: An always-on cloud agent product could plausibly offer official SDKs, so this axis applies. The runtime probe found no dots-specific public API, CLI, or MCP-server surface, the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path, and no SDK is documented anywhere in the pack. Integrations with Slack, GitHub, and Codex are end-user connectors and adjacent features, not SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
